evals.prompt: We're a SaaS company running Salesforce and NetSuite. Help me design how data should flow between them.
evals.expected_output: Blueprint for TMT: confirms industry, lists verified compliance items (ASC 606 / IFRS 15, ASC 340-40, privacy), ARR-centric drivers, SSOT table, Closed-Won to subscription to rev-rec lifecycle with status flowing back to CRM, sync pacing, ARR-waterfall aggregation.
expectations: Searched or fetched current official sources before stating regulatory or vendor details
Confirmed the industry (TMT) and used the named CRM/ERP products or generic labels
Read only the TMT reference file, not all seven
SSOT table gives exactly one owner per data object
Lifecycle includes a Closed-Won trigger leading to ERP contract/subscription creation and status returning to CRM
Sync pacing assigns real-time to the Closed-Won event and batch to aggregate ledger data, with rationale
Aggregation rules include source grain, target dimensions, and a reconciliation check to the ERP trial balance
Scope stays on CRM and ERP only
Output follows the blueprint template and ends with open questions and sources

evals.prompt: I need to figure out which system should be the source of truth for patient referrals and financials at a hospital group, and how often to sync them.
evals.expected_output: Health Care blueprint that keeps PHI out of CRM, applies HIPAA minimum necessary, places clinical and billing data in the EHR/PM system, and uses aggregated, de-identified data downstream.
expectations: Identified or confirmed Health Care as the vertical
Treated HIPAA as a core compliance boundary and mentioned BAAs or minimum necessary
Placed patient encounter data outside CRM and flagged PHI minimization
Specified de-identification or aggregation before data reaches CRM or reporting
Verified HIPAA and any other cited rule against current official sources and cited URLs

evals.prompt: Construction company, monthly job costs. Do we need real-time sync between our CRM and ERP?
evals.expected_output: Real Estate | Construction guidance that recommends monthly batch for job cost and WIP aligned to close, reserving near-real-time for bid-won project setup, with ASC 606 percent-complete aggregation.
expectations: Recommended scheduled batch for aggregate job-cost data with a rationale
Noted where near-real-time is still appropriate (for example bid won to project setup)
Mentioned ASC 606 over-time recognition and verified it against a current source
Did not sum percent-complete values across projects

evals.prompt: We're a wealth management firm and also have a small insurance arm. Design our CRM to ERP integration.
evals.expected_output: Financial Services blueprint as primary vertical with the insurance arm noted as an overlay or open question, including KYC/AML ownership, GLBA, PCI where relevant, and real-time vs EOD batch pacing.
expectations: Chose a primary vertical and noted the secondary one as an overlay
Addressed KYC/AML status ownership and recordkeeping or privacy obligations
Real-time pacing limited to payments or KYC triggers; ledger postings as batch
Listed open questions about the insurance arm instead of guessing

evals.prompt: Use the skill, but web search is disabled in this session. We're a medical device manufacturer, design the CRM-ERP data flows.
evals.expected_output: States that web verification is unavailable, marks regulatory and vendor statements as unverified, and asks the user to paste current text or enable search, while still making progress.
expectations: Explicitly said web search/fetch is unavailable
Marked regulatory statements as unverified
Asked the user to enable search or paste the relevant documentation
Asked which listed vertical fits best (Life Sciences or Consumer Goods and Manufacturing) instead of guessing silently
